partes.pasos: Open the login page and click the "Log in" button.

partes.titulo: App closes when I open photos
Images don't load on the blog
partes.pasos: Go to the blog and open any post.
partes.actual: The images are empty grey boxes.

partes.titulo: Calendar shows the wrong time for meetings
partes.pasos: Create a meeting at 10:00 and open the calendar.

partes.titulo: Search returns no results for words with accents
partes.pasos: Type "café" in the search box and press Enter.
partes.esperado: The search shows products that contain "café".

partes.titulo: Export to CSV fails with more than 1,000 rows
partes.pasos: Filter the report so that it has over 1,000 rows, then click "Export to CSV".
partes.esperado: A CSV file with all the rows is downloaded.

partes.titulo: Cart is emptied after logging in
partes.pasos: Add two items to the cart as a guest, then log in to an existing account.
partes.esperado: The items remain in the cart after logging in.
partes.actual: The cart is empty once the user has logged in.

partes.titulo: Some users get every notification twice
partes.pasos: Assign a task to a user who belongs to two teams.
partes.esperado: The user receives one notification per assignment.
partes.actual: The user receives a duplicate notification, one from each team.

partes.titulo: Intermittent 500 errors on concurrent saves to the same document
partes.pasos: Have two users save changes to the same document within a second of each other.
partes.esperado: Both changes are saved, or the second user is told about the conflict.
partes.actual: Roughly one in ten requests fails with a 500 error, and the second change is silently lost.

partes.titulo: Layout shift on product pages causes mis-taps on slow networks
partes.pasos: Throttle the network to "Slow 3G" and open any product page.
partes.esperado: The page stays stable while images and fonts load.
partes.actual: The "Add to cart" button moves down by about 200 px when the main image loads, so users tap the wrong thing.
